degraded_seats.note: Applied only when state.json.preflight.mode is 'degraded-claude-only' (product/onboarding/preflight.md check 2 fails). Every seat below is a same-family Claude substitute for a seat this config's own "seats" section names as GPT-5.6-Sol-only, so no seat parks in degraded mode and the build completes end to end (P3 Sol review BLOCKER-2 remedy). The honest trade-off is losing cross-family error decorrelation — two different model families being wrong in different, uncorrelated ways — never a loss of throughput or a skipped seat.

implementer.note: Fable-never-implements ban still holds; Opus already owns UI/creative implementation in full-cross-family mode and becomes the sole degraded-mode implementer for every chunk, not just UI/creative ones.

chunk_review_of_claude_work.note: The reviewer must be a Claude model different from the chunk's own author, so degraded mode still gets two distinct minds on every chunk.
